units: <cite ref="Shabbat 57b:14">Sabb. 57ᵇ</cite> <he>כ׳ דעברא</he> a slave’s neck-chain, v. <cite ref="K00041"><he>כָּבוּל</he> II</cite>.
Ib. 58ᵃ כ׳ דעבדא תנן the Kabul of the Mishnah means &c.

<cite ref="Shabbat 54a:4">Ib. 54ᵃ</cite> (v. <cite ref="K00040"><he>כָּבוּל</he> I</cite>) it was named Cabul <he>דמשתרגא בה כרעא עד כ׳</he> ed. (Ar. <he>דמשתקעא</he>) because the foot is entangled in (sinks into) the sandy soil up to the ankle-band; [oth. vers. in Ar. <he>דמשתקעא כרעא בגווה כי כ׳</he> (read <he>דמשתרגא</he>) because the foot is entangled in it as if in a foot-chain.]—Pl. <he>כְּבָלִין</he>, <he>כַּבְלֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Lamentations 3:7">Targ. Lam. III, 7</cite>.
Targ. Ps. CXLIX, 8 (Ms. sing).
